content: Traditional render farm job schedulers (table stakes): asset sync to shared storage, frame-splitting across a node fleet, job priority/resource-label matching, pre-flight (asset fetch) and post-flight (result copy + completion marking) hooks. Advanced/differentiating capabilities: hybrid CPU/GPU routing per render-pass type (e.g. GPU for beauty pass, CPU for volumetrics exceeding VRAM), multi-pass compositing pipelines, and partitioning a single GPU's render target into multiple render-target units for parallel multi-client allocation.
